Eng:

古蹟建築結構將隨機生成的古代遺跡、 Forgotten 寺廟和神祕儀式場地添加到您的世界中。每個結構都隱藏著失落文明的秘密，細緻的細節和氛圍感極強的破敗景象讓人忍不住去探索並講述故事。

💬 加入 Discord 伺服器以取得更新、提供反饋和建議：
👉 Discord

 

Русский:

Old Ruins Structures adds procedurally generated ancient ruins, forgotten temples, and mysterious ritual sites to your world. Each structure holds secrets of lost civilizations, featuring intricate details and atmospheric decay that invite exploration and storytelling.
